timing_method: One warmup then seven alternating paired repetitions, pinned to CPU 0, using complete-process child user+system CPU time. Selected confirmations use 21 repetitions. Memory runs rotate Umber, pdfTeX, and baseline order; allocation diagnostics use separate instrumented adapters.

memory.scope: Full-process CPU/wall medians; allocator requests cover engine construction/execution and exclude the compact host input. Heap peaks are requested bytes, not RSS. pdfTeX memory is not measured by this adapter.
